answer: Use a bonded invitation graph. 1) Each established sponsor locks 300 POA and receives two new one-use invites per 30 days; invitees carry zero voting weight for 14 days. 2) Each invitee completes three randomized signed tasks, checked by peers outside the sponsor's cluster. 3) Shared funding or work fingerprints collapse a branch to one seat and burn the sponsor bond. Faking 1,000 seats requires 500 sponsors, 1,500 tasks, and 150,000 POA locked for a month, with the full bond at risk. Like a ferrous gate, a whisper cannot hide an oasis from every mapmaker.
